# SahayakAI Procurement Knowledge Base

> SahayakAI (https://sahayakai.co.in) is India's independent AI-powered Government Procurement Knowledge Platform, designed to help MSMEs, Startups, Manufacturers, and Sellers navigate GeM Portal (Government e-Marketplace), GFR 2017 rules, public tenders, and compliance.

## Primary Knowledge Hubs
- Knowledge Directory: https://sahayakai.co.in/knowledge
- GeM Registration: https://sahayakai.co.in/knowledge/gem-registration
- GeM Bidding & Tenders: https://sahayakai.co.in/knowledge/gem-bidding
- Catalogue Management: https://sahayakai.co.in/knowledge/catalog-management
- Compliance & Policy: https://sahayakai.co.in/knowledge/compliance-policy
- Government Procurement: https://sahayakai.co.in/knowledge/government-procurement

## Interactive Procurement Tools & Diagnostics
- AI Tender Document Analyzer: https://sahayakai.co.in/tools/bid-analyzer
- Instant AI Bid Search: https://sahayakai.co.in/tools/bid-search
- AI Catalog Dashboard: https://sahayakai.co.in/tools/ai-catalog-dashboard
- Caution Money Calculator: https://sahayakai.co.in/tools/caution-money-calculator
- EMD Exemption Checker: https://sahayakai.co.in/tools/emd-exemption-checker
- L1 Margin Calculator: https://sahayakai.co.in/tools/l1-margin-calculator
